## In our context

::: {.tip}
- Trees and ensembles **do not extrapolate**: outside the training range the prediction is flat
- Feature importance is a check against physics — does load matter more than an irrelevant ID column?
- Boosting is often the most accurate surrogate on tabular calculation results; its limits must still be stated
:::
